 1 | # API Keys (Required to enable respective provider)
 2 | ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your_anthropic_api_key_here"       # Required: Format: sk-ant-api03-...
 3 | PERPLEXITY_API_KEY="your_perplexity_api_key_here"     # Optional: Format: pplx-...
 4 | OPENAI_API_KEY="your_openai_api_key_here"             # Optional, for OpenAI/OpenRouter models. Format: sk-proj-...
 5 | GOOGLE_API_KEY="your_google_api_key_here"             # Optional, for Google Gemini models.
 6 | MISTRAL_API_KEY="your_mistral_key_here"               # Optional, for Mistral AI models.
 7 | XAI_API_KEY="YOUR_XAI_KEY_HERE"                       # Optional, for xAI AI models.
 8 | AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY="your_azure_key_here"            # Optional, for Azure OpenAI models (requires endpoint in .taskmaster/config.json).
 9 | OLLAMA_API_KEY="your_ollama_api_key_here"             # Optional: For remote Ollama servers that require authentication.
10 | GITHUB_API_KEY="your_github_api_key_here"             # Optional: For GitHub import/export features. Format: ghp_... or github_pat_...

/.github/workflows/publish.yml:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | name: Publish to NPM
 2 | 
 3 | on:
 4 |   push:
 5 |     tags:
 6 |       - 'v*'
 7 |   workflow_dispatch:
 8 |     inputs:
 9 |       version:
10 |         description: 'Version to publish'
11 |         required: true
12 |         default: '1.0.0'
13 | 
14 | jobs:
15 |   publish:
16 |     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
17 |     
18 |     steps:
19 |     - name: Checkout code
20 |       uses: actions/checkout@v4
21 |       
22 |     - name: Setup Node.js
23 |       uses: actions/setup-node@v4
24 |       with:
25 |         node-version: '18'
26 |         registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
27 |         
28 |     - name: Install dependencies
29 |       run: npm ci
30 |       
31 |     - name: Run pre-publish checks
32 |       run: npm run pre-publish
33 |       
34 |     - name: Build project
35 |       run: npm run build
36 |       
37 |     - name: Run tests
38 |       run: npm run test:all
39 |       
40 |     - name: Publish to NPM
41 |       run: npm publish --access public
42 |       env:
43 |         NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
44 |         
45 |     - name: Create GitHub Release
46 |       uses: actions/create-release@v1
47 |       env:
48 |         GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
49 |       with:
50 |         tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
51 |         release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
52 |         body: |
53 |           ## 🚀 MCP Interface Validator Release
54 |           
55 |           ### 📦 Installation
56 |           ```bash
57 |           npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
58 |           ```
59 |           
60 |           ### 🔧 Quick Setup
61 |           ```bash
62 |           npm run install:global
63 |           ```
64 |           
65 |           ### 📚 Documentation
66 |           - [User Guide](https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator/blob/main/USER_README.md)
67 |           - [Installation Guide](https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator/blob/main/INSTALLATION.md)
68 |           - [API Reference](https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator/tree/main/docs/api)
69 |           
70 |           ### 🎯 What's New
71 |           - Complete MCP interface validation system
72 |           - Intelligent constraint engine with `.use interface` support
73 |           - Multi AI tool compatibility (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Augment)
74 |           - Real-time validation and monitoring
75 |           - Comprehensive documentation and examples
76 |         draft: false
77 |         prerelease: false
78 |

/INSTALLATION.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | # 📦 MCP接口验证组件 - 安装指南
  2 | 
  3 | ## 🚀 快速安装
  4 | 
  5 | ### 方法1：NPM全局安装（推荐）
  6 | 
  7 | ```bash
  8 | # 安装包
  9 | npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
 10 | 
 11 | # 自动配置MCP
 12 | npm run install:global
 13 | ```
 14 | 
 15 | ### 方法2：从源码安装
 16 | 
 17 | ```bash
 18 | # 克隆仓库
 19 | git clone https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator.git
 20 | cd mcp-interface-validator
 21 | 
 22 | # 安装依赖
 23 | npm install
 24 | 
 25 | # 构建项目
 26 | npm run build
 27 | 
 28 | # 全局链接
 29 | npm link
 30 | ```
 31 | 
 32 | ### 方法3：直接从GitHub安装
 33 | 
 34 | ```bash
 35 | npm install -g https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator.git
 36 | ```
 37 | 
 38 | ## ⚙️ MCP配置
 39 | 
 40 | ### Claude Desktop配置
 41 | 
 42 | **Windows路径**: `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`
 43 | **macOS路径**: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
 44 | **Linux路径**: `~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`
 45 | 
 46 | **正确的配置格式**:
 47 | ```json
 48 | {
 49 |   "mcpServers": {
 50 |     "interface-validator": {
 51 |       "command": "mcp-interface-validator",
 52 |       "transport": "stdio",
 53 |       "env": {
 54 |         "NODE_ENV": "production"
 55 |       },
 56 |       "autoStart": true
 57 |     }
 58 |   }
 59 | }
 60 | ```
 61 | 
 62 | ### 其他AI工具配置
 63 | 
 64 | #### Cursor
 65 | 文件: `.cursor/config.json`
 66 | ```json
 67 | {
 68 |   "mcp": {
 69 |     "servers": {
 70 |       "interface-validator": {
 71 |         "command": "mcp-interface-validator",
 72 |         "args": ["--port", "3001"]
 73 |       }
 74 |     }
 75 |   }
 76 | }
 77 | ```
 78 | 
 79 | #### Windsurf
 80 | 文件: `windsurf.config.json`
 81 | ```json
 82 | {
 83 |   "mcpServers": {
 84 |     "interface-validator": {
 85 |       "command": "mcp-interface-validator",
 86 |       "transport": "stdio"
 87 |     }
 88 |   }
 89 | }
 90 | ```
 91 | 
 92 | ## 🔍 验证安装
 93 | 
 94 | ### 1. 检查版本
 95 | ```bash
 96 | mcp-interface-validator --version
 97 | ```
 98 | 
 99 | ### 2. 检查工具状态
100 | ```bash
101 | mcp-interface-validator --status
102 | ```
103 | 
104 | ### 3. 在AI工具中测试
105 | 重启AI工具后，应该能看到以下工具：
106 | - `validate-interface`
107 | - `activate-interface-constraints`
108 | - `apply-interface-constraints`
109 | - `monitor-changes`
110 | 
111 | ## 🛠️ 故障排除
112 | 
113 | ### 问题1: 命令未找到
114 | ```bash
115 | # 检查全局安装
116 | npm list -g mcp-interface-validator
117 | 
118 | # 重新安装
119 | npm uninstall -g mcp-interface-validator
120 | npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
121 | ```
122 | 
123 | ### 问题2: MCP连接失败
124 | 1. 检查配置文件JSON格式是否正确
125 | 2. 确保命令路径正确
126 | 3. 重启AI工具
127 | 
128 | ### 问题3: 权限错误
129 | ```bash
130 | # Windows (以管理员身份运行)
131 | npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
132 | 
133 | # macOS/Linux
134 | sudo npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
135 | ```
136 | 
137 | ## 📚 下一步
138 | 
139 | 安装完成后，请查看：
140 | - [用户指南](USER_README.md) - 详细使用说明
141 | - [API文档](docs/api/) - 工具命令参考
142 | - [示例配置](docs/examples/) - 更多配置示例
143 | 
144 | ## 🆘 获取帮助
145 | 
146 | - 📧 邮件支持: 1334089073@qq.com
147 | - 🐛 问题反馈: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator/issues)
148 | - 📚 完整文档: [项目主页](https://github.com/xiaoxiaofeiya/mcp-interface-validator)
149 |

 1 | /**
 2 |  * Schema Validator for OpenAPI Specifications
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Handles loading, parsing, and validating OpenAPI schemas
 5 |  */
 6 | import type { OpenAPIV3, OpenAPIV3_1 } from 'openapi-types';
 7 | import { Logger } from '../../utils/logger/index.js';
 8 | import type { ValidationConfig } from '../../utils/config/index.js';
 9 | export type OpenAPISpec = OpenAPIV3.Document | OpenAPIV3_1.Document;
10 | export interface SchemaValidationResult {
11 |     isValid: boolean;
12 |     errors: SchemaValidationError[];
13 |     warnings: SchemaValidationWarning[];
14 | }
15 | export interface SchemaValidationError {
16 |     path: string;
17 |     message: string;
18 |     value?: any;
19 |     schema?: any;
20 | }
21 | export interface SchemaValidationWarning {
22 |     path: string;
23 |     message: string;
24 |     suggestion?: string;
25 | }
26 | export declare class SchemaValidator {
27 |     private logger;
28 |     private _config;
29 |     private ajv;
30 |     private loadedSpecs;
31 |     constructor(config: ValidationConfig, logger: Logger);
32 |     /**
33 |      * Initialize the schema validator
34 |      */
35 |     initialize(): Promise<void>;
36 |     /**
37 |      * Load and parse OpenAPI specification from file
38 |      */
39 |     loadSpecification(specPath: string): Promise<OpenAPISpec>;
40 |     /**
41 |      * Validate data against a schema from the OpenAPI specification
42 |      */
43 |     validateAgainstSchema(data: any, schema: any, schemaPath?: string): SchemaValidationResult;
44 |     /**
45 |      * Get schema for a specific path and method from OpenAPI spec
46 |      */
47 |     getPathSchema(spec: OpenAPISpec, path: string, method: string): any;
48 |     /**
49 |      * Get request body schema for a specific operation
50 |      */
51 |     getRequestBodySchema(operation: any, contentType?: string): any;
52 |     /**
53 |      * Get response schema for a specific operation and status code
54 |      */
55 |     getResponseSchema(operation: any, statusCode: string, contentType?: string): any;
56 |     /**
57 |      * Clear cached specifications
58 |      */
59 |     clearCache(): void;
60 |     /**
61 |      * Add custom OpenAPI format validators
62 |      */
63 |     private addOpenAPIFormats;
64 |     /**
65 |      * Get validation statistics
66 |      */
67 |     getStats(): {
68 |         cachedSpecs: number;
69 |     };
70 | }

 1 | /**
 2 |  * Security Module Type Definitions
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Comprehensive type definitions for the security module
 5 |  */
 6 | // Security Error Types
 7 | export class SecurityError extends Error {
 8 |     code;
 9 |     severity;
10 |     metadata;
11 |     constructor(message, code, severity = 'medium', metadata) {
12 |         super(message);
13 |         this.code = code;
14 |         this.severity = severity;
15 |         this.metadata = metadata;
16 |         this.name = 'SecurityError';
17 |     }
18 | }
19 | export class AuthenticationError extends SecurityError {
20 |     constructor(message, metadata) {
21 |         super(message, 'AUTH_ERROR', 'medium', metadata);
22 |         this.name = 'AuthenticationError';
23 |     }
24 | }
25 | export class AuthorizationError extends SecurityError {
26 |     constructor(message, metadata) {
27 |         super(message, 'AUTHZ_ERROR', 'medium', metadata);
28 |         this.name = 'AuthorizationError';
29 |     }
30 | }
31 | export class EncryptionError extends SecurityError {
32 |     constructor(message, metadata) {
33 |         super(message, 'ENCRYPTION_ERROR', 'high', metadata);
34 |         this.name = 'EncryptionError';
35 |     }
36 | }
37 | export class RateLimitError extends SecurityError {
38 |     constructor(message, metadata) {
39 |         super(message, 'RATE_LIMIT_ERROR', 'low', metadata);
40 |         this.name = 'RateLimitError';
41 |     }
42 | }

/build/core/version-control/providers/filesystem-provider.d.ts:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | /**
 2 |  * File System Provider for Version Control System
 3 |  *
 4 |  * This provider implements version control using the local file system as storage.
 5 |  */
 6 | import type { Logger } from '../../../utils/logger/index.js';
 7 | import type { VersionControlProvider, FileSystemProvider as IFileSystemProvider, FileSystemProviderConfig, VersionEntry, BranchInfo, ConflictResolution } from '../types.js';
 8 | /**
 9 |  * File System Provider Implementation
10 |  */
11 | export declare class FileSystemProvider implements VersionControlProvider, IFileSystemProvider {
12 |     private config;
13 |     private logger;
14 |     private basePath;
15 |     private initialized;
16 |     constructor(config: FileSystemProviderConfig, logger: Logger);
17 |     /**
18 |      * Initialize the file system provider
19 |      */
20 |     initialize(): Promise<void>;
21 |     /**
22 |      * Store a version in the file system
23 |      */
24 |     storeVersion(version: VersionEntry): Promise<void>;
25 |     /**
26 |      * Get a version from the file system
27 |      */
28 |     getVersion(specId: string, versionId: string): Promise<VersionEntry | null>;
29 |     /**
30 |      * Load version history from the file system
31 |      */
32 |     loadHistory(): Promise<Map<string, VersionEntry[]>>;
33 |     /**
34 |      * Create a new branch
35 |      */
36 |     createBranch(specId: string, branchName: string, fromVersionId: string): Promise<void>;
37 |     /**
38 |      * Merge branches (simplified implementation)
39 |      */
40 |     mergeBranch(specId: string, sourceBranch: string, targetBranch: string, _conflictResolution?: ConflictResolution): Promise<VersionEntry>;
41 |     /**
42 |      * List branches for a specification
43 |      */
44 |     listBranches(specId: string): Promise<BranchInfo[]>;
45 |     /**
46 |      * Delete a branch
47 |      */
48 |     deleteBranch(specId: string, branchName: string): Promise<void>;
49 |     /**
50 |      * Ensure directory exists
51 |      */
52 |     ensureDirectory(dirPath: string): Promise<void>;
53 |     /**
54 |      * Write file
55 |      */

/build/integrations/index.d.ts:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | /**
 2 |  * Integration Manager for AI Tools
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Manages integrations with various AI development tools
 5 |  */
 6 | import { Logger } from '../utils/logger/index.js';
 7 | import { ConfigManager } from '../utils/config/index.js';
 8 | export interface Integration {
 9 |     name: string;
10 |     isEnabled: boolean;
11 |     initialize(): Promise<void>;
12 |     sendValidationResult(result: any): Promise<void>;
13 |     getStatus(): IntegrationStatus;
14 | }
15 | export interface IntegrationStatus {
16 |     name: string;
17 |     enabled: boolean;
18 |     connected: boolean;
19 |     lastActivity?: string | undefined;
20 |     errorCount: number;
21 | }
22 | export declare class IntegrationManager {
23 |     private logger;
24 |     private config;
25 |     private integrations;
26 |     private isInitialized;
27 |     constructor(configManager: ConfigManager, logger: Logger);
28 |     /**
29 |      * Initialize all enabled integrations
30 |      */
31 |     initialize(): Promise<void>;
32 |     /**
33 |      * Send validation results to all enabled integrations
34 |      */
35 |     broadcastValidationResult(result: any): Promise<void>;
36 |     /**
37 |      * Get status of all integrations
38 |      */
39 |     getIntegrationsStatus(): IntegrationStatus[];
40 |     /**
41 |      * Get specific integration by name
42 |      */
43 |     getIntegration(name: string): Integration | undefined;
44 |     /**
45 |      * Enable/disable specific integration
46 |      */
47 |     toggleIntegration(name: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void>;
48 |     /**
49 |      * Get manager status
50 |      */
51 |     getStatus(): {
52 |         initialized: boolean;
53 |         integrationCount: number;
54 |     };
55 | }
56 | //# sourceMappingURL=index.d.ts.map

11 | }

23 |      */
24 |     initialize(): Promise<void>;
25 |     /**
26 |      * Send validation result to Trae
27 |      */

30 |      * Get integration status
31 |      */

34 |      * Enable the integration
35 |      */

38 |      * Disable the integration

 1 | /**
 2 |  * Configuration Manager for MCP Interface Validator
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Manages application configuration from various sources
 5 |  */
 6 | export interface ValidationConfig {
 7 |     strictMode: boolean;
 8 |     allowAdditionalProperties: boolean;
 9 |     validateExamples: boolean;
10 |     customRules: string[];
11 | }
12 | export interface IntegrationConfig {
13 |     cursor: {
14 |         enabled: boolean;
15 |         configPath?: string;
16 |     };
17 |     windsurf: {
18 |         enabled: boolean;
19 |         configPath?: string;
20 |     };
21 |     augment: {
22 |         enabled: boolean;
23 |         configPath?: string;
24 |     };
25 |     trae: {
26 |         enabled: boolean;
27 |         configPath?: string;
28 |     };
29 | }
30 | export interface MonitoringConfig {
31 |     watchPatterns: string[];
32 |     ignorePatterns: string[];
33 |     debounceMs: number;
34 |     maxFileSize: number;
35 | }
36 | export interface MCPConfig {
37 |     server: {
38 |         name: string;
39 |         version: string;
40 |         description: string;
41 |     };
42 |     validation: ValidationConfig;
43 |     integrations: IntegrationConfig;
44 |     monitoring: MonitoringConfig;
45 |     logging: {
46 |         level: string;
47 |         format: string;
48 |     };
49 | }
50 | export declare class ConfigManager {
51 |     private config;
52 |     private configPath;
53 |     constructor(configPath?: string);
54 |     /**
55 |      * Find configuration file in standard locations
56 |      */
57 |     private findConfigFile;
58 |     /**
59 |      * Load configuration from file or use defaults
60 |      */
61 |     private loadConfig;
62 |     /**
63 |      * Deep merge configuration objects
64 |      */
65 |     private mergeConfig;
66 |     /**
67 |      * Get full configuration
68 |      */
69 |     getConfig(): MCPConfig;
70 |     /**
71 |      * Get validation configuration
72 |      */
73 |     getValidationConfig(): ValidationConfig;
74 |     /**
75 |      * Get integration configuration
76 |      */
77 |     getIntegrationConfig(): IntegrationConfig;
78 |     /**
79 |      * Get monitoring configuration
80 |      */
81 |     getMonitoringConfig(): MonitoringConfig;
82 |     /**
83 |      * Get server configuration
84 |      */
85 |     getServerConfig(): MCPConfig['server'];
86 |     /**
87 |      * Update configuration
88 |      */
89 |     updateConfig(updates: Partial<MCPConfig>): void;
90 |     /**
91 |      * Get configuration file path
92 |      */
93 |     getConfigPath(): string;
94 | }

 1 | /**
 2 |  * Logger utility for the MCP Interface Validator
 3 |  */
 4 | export declare enum LogLevel {
 5 |     DEBUG = 0,
 6 |     INFO = 1,
 7 |     WARN = 2,
 8 |     ERROR = 3
 9 | }
10 | export interface LogEntry {
11 |     timestamp: string;
12 |     level: LogLevel;
13 |     component: string;
14 |     message: string;
15 |     data?: any;
16 | }
17 | export interface LoggerConfig {
18 |     level: LogLevel;
19 |     enableConsole: boolean;
20 |     enableFile: boolean;
21 |     maxLogEntries: number;
22 | }
23 | /**
24 |  * Logger class for structured logging
25 |  */
26 | export declare class Logger {
27 |     private component;
28 |     private config;
29 |     private logEntries;
30 |     constructor(component: string, config?: Partial<LoggerConfig>);
31 |     /**
32 |      * Log a debug message
33 |      */
34 |     debug(message: string, data?: any): void;
35 |     /**
36 |      * Log an info message
37 |      */
38 |     info(message: string, data?: any): void;
39 |     /**
40 |      * Log a warning message
41 |      */
42 |     warn(message: string, data?: any): void;
43 |     /**
44 |      * Log an error message
45 |      */
46 |     error(message: string, error?: any): void;
47 |     /**
48 |      * Core logging method
49 |      */
50 |     private log;
51 |     /**
52 |      * Output log entry to console
53 |      */
54 |     private outputToConsole;
55 |     /**
56 |      * Get recent log entries
57 |      */
58 |     getLogEntries(count?: number): LogEntry[];
59 |     /**
60 |      * Clear log entries
61 |      */
62 |     clearLogs(): void;
63 |     /**
64 |      * Update logger configuration
65 |      */
66 |     updateConfig(config: Partial<LoggerConfig>): void;
67 |     /**
68 |      * Get current configuration
69 |      */
70 |     getConfig(): LoggerConfig;
71 | }
72 | /**
73 |  * Global logger instance
74 |  */
75 | export declare const globalLogger: Logger;
76 | export default Logger;

 1 | /**
 2 |  * Logger Utility for MCP Interface Validator
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Provides structured logging with different levels and formatting
 5 |  */
 6 | export declare enum LogLevel {
 7 |     DEBUG = 0,
 8 |     INFO = 1,
 9 |     WARN = 2,
10 |     ERROR = 3
11 | }
12 | export interface LogEntry {
13 |     timestamp: string;
14 |     level: LogLevel;
15 |     component: string;
16 |     message: string;
17 |     data?: any;
18 | }
19 | export declare class Logger {
20 |     private component;
21 |     private logLevel;
22 |     constructor(component: string, logLevel?: LogLevel);
23 |     /**
24 |      * Log debug message
25 |      */
26 |     debug(message: string, data?: any): void;
27 |     /**
28 |      * Log info message
29 |      */
30 |     info(message: string, data?: any): void;
31 |     /**
32 |      * Log warning message
33 |      */
34 |     warn(message: string, data?: any): void;
35 |     /**
36 |      * Log error message
37 |      */
38 |     error(message: string, error?: any): void;
39 |     /**
40 |      * Internal logging method
41 |      */
42 |     private log;

44 |      * Format log entry for output
45 |      */

48 |      * Set log level
49 |      */

53 |      */
54 |     getLogLevel(): LogLevel;
55 | }

/build/utils/logger/index.js:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | /**
 2 |  * Logger Utility for MCP Interface Validator
 3 |  *
 4 |  * Provides structured logging with different levels and formatting
 5 |  */
 6 | export var LogLevel;
 7 | (function (LogLevel) {
 8 |     LogLevel[LogLevel["DEBUG"] = 0] = "DEBUG";
 9 |     LogLevel[LogLevel["INFO"] = 1] = "INFO";
10 |     LogLevel[LogLevel["WARN"] = 2] = "WARN";
11 |     LogLevel[LogLevel["ERROR"] = 3] = "ERROR";
12 | })(LogLevel || (LogLevel = {}));
13 | export class Logger {
14 |     component;
15 |     logLevel;
16 |     constructor(component, logLevel = LogLevel.INFO) {
17 |         this.component = component;
18 |         this.logLevel = logLevel;
19 |     }
20 |     /**
21 |      * Log debug message
22 |      */
23 |     debug(message, data) {
24 |         this.log(LogLevel.DEBUG, message, data);
25 |     }
26 |     /**
27 |      * Log info message
28 |      */
29 |     info(message, data) {
30 |         this.log(LogLevel.INFO, message, data);
31 |     }
32 |     /**
33 |      * Log warning message
34 |      */
35 |     warn(message, data) {
36 |         this.log(LogLevel.WARN, message, data);
37 |     }
38 |     /**
39 |      * Log error message
40 |      */
41 |     error(message, error) {
42 |         this.log(LogLevel.ERROR, message, error);
43 |     }
44 |     /**
45 |      * Internal logging method
46 |      */
47 |     log(level, message, data) {
48 |         if (level < this.logLevel) {
49 |             return;
50 |         }
51 |         const entry = {
52 |             timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
53 |             level,
54 |             component: this.component,
55 |             message,
56 |             data
57 |         };
58 |         const formattedMessage = this.formatLogEntry(entry);
59 |         switch (level) {
60 |             case LogLevel.DEBUG:
61 |                 console.debug(formattedMessage);
62 |                 break;
63 |             case LogLevel.INFO:
64 |                 console.info(formattedMessage);
65 |                 break;
66 |             case LogLevel.WARN:
67 |                 console.warn(formattedMessage);
68 |                 break;
69 |             case LogLevel.ERROR:
70 |                 console.error(formattedMessage);
71 |                 break;
72 |         }
73 |     }
74 |     /**
75 |      * Format log entry for output
76 |      */
77 |     formatLogEntry(entry) {
78 |         const levelName = LogLevel[entry.level];
79 |         let formatted = `[${entry.timestamp}] ${levelName} [${entry.component}] ${entry.message}`;
80 |         if (entry.data) {
81 |             formatted += `\n${JSON.stringify(entry.data, null, 2)}`;
82 |         }
83 |         return formatted;
84 |     }
85 |     /**
86 |      * Set log level
87 |      */
88 |     setLogLevel(level) {
89 |         this.logLevel = level;
90 |     }
91 |     /**
92 |      * Get current log level
93 |      */
94 |     getLogLevel() {
95 |         return this.logLevel;
96 |     }
97 | }
98 | //# sourceMappingURL=index.js.map

  1 | # SQLite数据库验证报告
  2 | 
  3 | ## 概述
  4 | 
  5 | 本报告详细记录了MCP接口验证组件项目中SQLite数据库功能的验证结果。
  6 | 
  7 | ## 验证日期
  8 | - **验证时间**: 2025-07-02
  9 | - **验证环境**: Windows 11, Node.js v22.16.0
 10 | - **SQLite版本**: 5.1.7
 11 | 
 12 | ## 验证结果
 13 | 
 14 | ### ✅ 基础功能验证 - 全部通过
 15 | 
 16 | 1. **数据库创建和连接** ✅
 17 |    - 内存数据库创建成功
 18 |    - 数据库连接建立正常
 19 |    - 连接关闭功能正常
 20 | 
 21 | 2. **表结构创建** ✅
 22 |    - 简单表创建成功
 23 |    - 复杂表结构创建成功（包含多种数据类型）
 24 |    - 主键和约束设置正常
 25 | 
 26 | 3. **数据操作** ✅
 27 |    - 数据插入功能正常
 28 |    - 数据查询功能正常
 29 |    - 数据更新功能正常
 30 |    - 数据删除功能正常
 31 | 
 32 | ### ✅ 高级功能验证 - 全部通过
 33 | 
 34 | 4. **索引管理** ✅
 35 |    - 单列索引创建成功
 36 |    - 多列索引创建成功
 37 |    - 索引查询优化正常
 38 |

 53 | 
 54 | ## 项目特定功能验证
 55 | 
 56 | ### ✅ ValidationHistory表结构
 57 | ```sql
 58 | CREATE TABLE validation_history (
 59 |   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 60 |   spec_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 61 |   timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL,

 67 |   context TEXT,
 68 |   metrics TEXT,
 69 |   created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 70 |   updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
 71 | )
 72 | ```
 73 | - 表结构创建成功 ✅
 74 | - 所有字段类型正确 ✅
 75 | - 默认值设置正常 ✅
 76 | 
 77 | ### ✅ 索引优化

103 | ## 测试环境问题解决
104 | 
105 | ### 问题描述
106 | 在Jest测试环境中遇到SQLite Mock配置复杂性问题，导致测试执行困难。
107 | 
108 | ### 解决方案
109 | 1. **创建独立验证脚本**: 绕过Jest复杂的Mock系统
110 | 2. **直接功能验证**: 使用真实SQLite实例进行验证
111 | 3. **分离测试策略**: 将SQLite功能验证与单元测试分离
112 |

114 | - ✅ **功能验证优先**: 确保SQLite核心功能正常
115 | - ✅ **实际使用场景**: 测试项目中实际使用的功能
116 | - ✅ **性能验证**: 确保批量操作和复杂查询性能
117 |

/docs/examples/cursor-integration.md:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | # Cursor AI 集成指南
 2 | 
 3 | ## 概述
 4 | 
 5 | 本指南展示如何在Cursor AI编程工具中集成MCP接口验证组件，实现AI生成代码之前的自动接口验证。
 6 | 
 7 | ## 配置步骤
 8 | 
 9 | ### 1. 安装MCP接口验证器
10 | 
11 | ```bash
12 | npm install -g mcp-interface-validator
13 | ```
14 | 
15 | ### 2. 配置Cursor设置
16 | 
17 | 在Cursor的设置中添加MCP服务器配置：
18 | 
19 | ```json
20 | {
21 |   "mcp": {
22 |     "servers": {
23 |       "interface-validator": {
24 |         "command": "mcp-interface-validator",
25 |         "args": ["--stdio"],
26 |         "env": {
27 |           "NODE_ENV": "production"
28 |         }
29 |       }
30 |     }
31 |   }
32 | }
33 | ```
34 | 
35 | ### 3. 使用示例
36 | 
37 | 当AI生成代码时，系统会自动：
38 | 
39 | 1. **检测API接口代码**：识别前端和后端的API调用
40 | 2. **验证接口一致性**：对比OpenAPI规范
41 | 3. **提供实时反馈**：在代码生成前注入验证结果
42 | 4. **建议修复方案**：自动提供接口不匹配的修复建议
43 | 
44 | ### 4. 工作流程
45 | 
46 | ```mermaid
47 | graph TD
48 |     A[用户输入代码需求] --> B[AI开始生成代码]
49 |     B --> C[MCP验证器拦截]
50 |     C --> D[解析API接口]
51 |     D --> E[对比OpenAPI规范]
52 |     E --> F{验证通过?}
53 |     F -->|是| G[生成代码]
54 |     F -->|否| H[提供修复建议]
55 |     H --> I[AI调整代码]
56 |     I --> C
57 |     G --> J[完成代码生成]
58 | ```
59 | 
60 | ## 验证功能
61 | 
62 | - ✅ **端点验证**：检查API端点是否存在于规范中
63 | - ✅ **参数验证**：验证请求参数类型和必需性
64 | - ✅ **响应验证**：检查响应格式是否符合规范
65 | - ✅ **类型安全**：确保TypeScript类型定义一致
66 | - ✅ **实时监控**：文件变更时自动重新验证
67 | 
68 | ## 配置选项
69 | 
70 | ```json
71 | {
72 |   "validation": {
73 |     "strictMode": true,
74 |     "allowAdditionalProperties": false,
75 |     "validateExamples": true,
76 |     "customRules": [
77 |       "require-response-schemas",
78 |       "validate-parameter-types",
79 |       "check-security-definitions"
80 |     ]
81 |   },
82 |   "monitoring": {
83 |     "watchPatterns": ["**/*.ts", "**/*.js"],
84 |     "debounceMs": 500
85 |   }
86 | }
87 | ```
88 |

/fix-imports.js:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | #!/usr/bin/env node
 2 | 
 3 | import fs from 'fs';
 4 | import path from 'path';
 5 | import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
 6 | 
 7 | const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
 8 | const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
 9 | 
10 | function fixImportsInFile(filePath) {
11 |     try {
12 |         let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
13 |         let modified = false;
14 | 
15 |         // Fix relative imports that don't have .js extension
16 |         const importRegex = /from\s+['"](\.[^'"]*?)['"];?/g;
17 |         content = content.replace(importRegex, (match, importPath) => {
18 |             // Skip if already has .js extension
19 |             if (importPath.endsWith('.js')) {
20 |                 return match;
21 |             }
22 | 
23 |             // Skip if not a relative path
24 |             if (!importPath.startsWith('.')) {
25 |                 return match;
26 |             }
27 | 
28 |             // Check if the path points to a directory that should have /index.js
29 |             const fullPath = path.resolve(path.dirname(filePath), importPath);
30 |             const indexPath = path.join(fullPath, 'index.js');
31 | 
32 |             let newImportPath;
33 |             if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) {
34 |                 // It's a directory with index.js
35 |                 newImportPath = importPath + '/index.js';
36 |             } else {
37 |                 // It's a file, add .js extension
38 |                 newImportPath = importPath + '.js';
39 |             }
40 | 
41 |             modified = true;
42 |             return match.replace(importPath, newImportPath);
43 |         });
44 | 
45 |         if (modified) {
46 |             fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
47 |             console.log(`Fixed imports in: ${filePath}`);
48 |         }
49 |     } catch (error) {
50 |         console.error(`Error processing ${filePath}:`, error.message);
51 |     }
52 | }
53 | 
54 | function walkDirectory(dir) {
55 |     const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
56 |     
57 |     for (const file of files) {
58 |         const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
59 |         const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
60 |         
61 |         if (stat.isDirectory()) {
62 |             walkDirectory(fullPath);
63 |         } else if (file.endsWith('.js')) {
64 |             fixImportsInFile(fullPath);
65 |         }
66 |     }
67 | }
68 | 
69 | // Start from build directory
70 | const buildDir = path.join(__dirname, 'build');
71 | if (fs.existsSync(buildDir)) {
72 |     console.log('Fixing ES module imports in build directory...');
73 |     walkDirectory(buildDir);
74 |     console.log('Import fixing completed!');
75 | } else {
76 |     console.error('Build directory not found!');
77 | }
78 | 


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/fix-source-imports.js:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | #!/usr/bin/env node
 2 | 
 3 | import fs from 'fs';
 4 | import path from 'path';
 5 | import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
 6 | 
 7 | const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
 8 | const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
 9 | 
10 | function fixImportsInSourceFile(filePath) {
11 |     try {
12 |         let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
13 |         let modified = false;
14 | 
15 |         // Fix relative imports that don't have .js extension
16 |         const importRegex = /from\s+['"](\.[^'"]*?)['"];?/g;
17 |         content = content.replace(importRegex, (match, importPath) => {
18 |             // Skip if already has .js extension
19 |             if (importPath.endsWith('.js')) {
20 |                 return match;
21 |             }
22 |             
23 |             // Skip if not a relative path
24 |             if (!importPath.startsWith('.')) {
25 |                 return match;
26 |             }
27 |             
28 |             // Check if the path points to a directory that should have /index.js
29 |             const fullPath = path.resolve(path.dirname(filePath), importPath);
30 |             const indexPath = path.join(fullPath, 'index.ts');
31 |             const directPath = fullPath + '.ts';
32 |             
33 |             let newImportPath;
34 |             if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) {
35 |                 // It's a directory with index.ts
36 |                 newImportPath = importPath + '/index.js';
37 |             } else if (fs.existsSync(directPath)) {
38 |                 // It's a file, add .js extension
39 |                 newImportPath = importPath + '.js';
40 |             } else {
41 |                 // Default to .js extension
42 |                 newImportPath = importPath + '.js';
43 |             }
44 |             
45 |             modified = true;
46 |             return match.replace(importPath, newImportPath);
47 |         });
48 | 
49 |         if (modified) {
50 |             fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
51 |             console.log(`Fixed source imports in: ${filePath}`);
52 |         }
53 |     } catch (error) {
54 |         console.error(`Error processing ${filePath}:`, error.message);
55 |     }
56 | }
57 | 
58 | function walkDirectory(dir) {
59 |     const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
60 |     
61 |     for (const file of files) {
62 |         const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
63 |         const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
64 |         
65 |         if (stat.isDirectory()) {
66 |             walkDirectory(fullPath);
67 |         } else if (file.endsWith('.ts') && !file.endsWith('.d.ts')) {
68 |             fixImportsInSourceFile(fullPath);
69 |         }
70 |     }
71 | }
72 | 
73 | // Start from src directory
74 | const srcDir = path.join(__dirname, 'src');
75 | if (fs.existsSync(srcDir)) {
76 |     console.log('Fixing ES module imports in source directory...');
77 |     walkDirectory(srcDir);
78 |     console.log('Source import fixing completed!');
79 | } else {
80 |     console.error('Source directory not found!');
81 | }
82 |

/fix-specific-imports.js:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | #!/usr/bin/env node
 2 | 
 3 | import fs from 'fs';
 4 | import path from 'path';
 5 | import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
 6 | 
 7 | const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
 8 | const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
 9 | 
10 | function fixSpecificImports(filePath) {
11 |     try {
12 |         let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
13 |         let modified = false;
14 | 
15 |         // Fix specific problematic imports
16 |         const fixes = [
17 |             {
18 |                 from: "from '../intelligent-context.js'",
19 |                 to: "from '../intelligent-context/index.js'"
20 |             },
21 |             {
22 |                 from: "from '../intelligent-context'",
23 |                 to: "from '../intelligent-context/index.js'"
24 |             },
25 |             {
26 |                 from: "from './intelligent-context.js'",
27 |                 to: "from './intelligent-context/index.js'"
28 |             },
29 |             {
30 |                 from: "from './intelligent-context'",
31 |                 to: "from './intelligent-context/index.js'"
32 |             }
33 |         ];
34 | 
35 |         for (const fix of fixes) {
36 |             if (content.includes(fix.from)) {
37 |                 content = content.replace(new RegExp(fix.from.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\
amp;'), 'g'), fix.to);
38 |                 modified = true;
39 |             }
40 |         }
41 | 
42 |         if (modified) {
43 |             fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
44 |             console.log(`Fixed specific imports in: ${filePath}`);
45 |         }
46 |     } catch (error) {
47 |         console.error(`Error processing ${filePath}:`, error.message);
48 |     }
49 | }
50 | 
51 | function walkDirectory(dir) {
52 |     const files = fs.readdirSync(dir);
53 |     
54 |     for (const file of files) {
55 |         const fullPath = path.join(dir, file);
56 |         const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
57 |         
58 |         if (stat.isDirectory()) {
59 |             walkDirectory(fullPath);
60 |         } else if (file.endsWith('.js')) {
61 |             fixSpecificImports(fullPath);
62 |         }
63 |     }
64 | }
65 | 
66 | // Start from build directory
67 | const buildDir = path.join(__dirname, 'build');
68 | if (fs.existsSync(buildDir)) {
69 |     console.log('Fixing specific import issues in build directory...');
70 |     walkDirectory(buildDir);
71 |     console.log('Specific import fixing completed!');
72 | } else {
73 |     console.error('Build directory not found!');
74 | }
75 |

/scripts/simple-sqlite-test.cjs:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | #!/usr/bin/env node
 2 | 
 3 | /**
 4 |  * 简单的SQLite测试脚本
 5 |  */
 6 | 
 7 | console.log('🔍 开始SQLite基础功能测试...');
 8 | 
 9 | try {
10 |   // 1. 尝试加载sqlite3模块
11 |   console.log('📦 加载sqlite3模块...');
12 |   const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
13 |   console.log('✅ sqlite3模块加载成功');
14 | 
15 |   // 2. 创建内存数据库
16 |   console.log('🧪 创建内存数据库...');
17 |   const db = new sqlite3.Database(':memory:', (err) => {
18 |     if (err) {
19 |       console.error('❌ 内存数据库创建失败:', err.message);
20 |       process.exit(1);
21 |     }
22 |     console.log('✅ 内存数据库创建成功');
23 |     
24 |     // 3. 创建测试表
25 |     console.log('🏗️  创建测试表...');
26 |     db.run(`CREATE TABLE test (
27 |       id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
28 |       name TEXT NOT NULL,
29 |       created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
30 |     )`, (err) => {
31 |       if (err) {
32 |         console.error('❌ 表创建失败:', err.message);
33 |         process.exit(1);
34 |       }
35 |       console.log('✅ 测试表创建成功');
36 |       
37 |       // 4. 插入测试数据
38 |       console.log('📝 插入测试数据...');
39 |       db.run(`INSERT INTO test (name) VALUES (?)`, ['测试数据'], function(err) {
40 |         if (err) {
41 |           console.error('❌ 数据插入失败:', err.message);
42 |           process.exit(1);
43 |         }
44 |         console.log('✅ 数据插入成功, ID:', this.lastID);
45 |         
46 |         // 5. 查询测试数据
47 |         console.log('🔍 查询测试数据...');
48 |         db.get(`SELECT * FROM test WHERE id = ?`, [this.lastID], (err, row) => {
49 |           if (err) {
50 |             console.error('❌ 数据查询失败:', err.message);
51 |             process.exit(1);
52 |           }
53 |           if (row) {
54 |             console.log('✅ 数据查询成功:', row);
55 |           } else {
56 |             console.error('❌ 未找到数据');
57 |             process.exit(1);
58 |           }
59 |           
60 |           // 6. 关闭数据库
61 |           console.log('🔒 关闭数据库...');
62 |           db.close((err) => {
63 |             if (err) {
64 |               console.error('❌ 数据库关闭失败:', err.message);
65 |               process.exit(1);
66 |             }
67 |             console.log('✅ 数据库关闭成功');
68 |             console.log('\n🎉 SQLite基础功能测试完成！');
69 |             console.log('✅ SQLite数据库功能正常，可以安全使用。');
70 |             process.exit(0);
71 |           });
72 |         });
73 |       });
74 |     });
75 |   });
76 | 
77 | } catch (error) {
78 |   console.error('❌ SQLite测试失败:', error.message);
79 |   console.error('🔧 请检查sqlite3模块安装: npm install sqlite3');
80 |   process.exit(1);
81 | }
82 |

/src/core/doc-generator/templates/minimal.hbs:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 1 | # {{spec.info.title}}
 2 | 
 3 | {{#if spec.info.description}}
 4 | {{spec.info.description}}
 5 | {{/if}}
 6 | 
 7 | Version: {{spec.info.version}}
 8 | 
 9 | ## Endpoints
10 | 
11 | {{#each operations}}
12 | ### {{uppercase method}} {{path}}
13 | 
14 | {{#if summary}}
15 | {{summary}}
16 | {{/if}}
17 | 
18 | {{#if parameters}}
19 | **Parameters:**
20 | {{#each parameters}}
21 | - `{{name}}` ({{in}}) - {{description}}{{#if required}} *Required*{{/if}}
22 | {{/each}}
23 | {{/if}}
24 |

/src/utils/logger/index.ts:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1 | /**
  2 |  * Logger Utility for MCP Interface Validator
  3 |  * 
  4 |  * Provides structured logging with different levels and formatting
  5 |  */
  6 | 
  7 | export enum LogLevel {
  8 |   DEBUG = 0,
  9 |   INFO = 1,
 10 |   WARN = 2,
 11 |   ERROR = 3
 12 | }
 13 | 
 14 | export interface LogEntry {
 15 |   timestamp: string;
 16 |   level: LogLevel;
 17 |   component: string;
 18 |   message: string;
 19 |   data?: any;
 20 | }
 21 | 
 22 | export class Logger {
 23 |   private component: string;
 24 |   private logLevel: LogLevel;
 25 | 
 26 |   constructor(component: string, logLevel: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO) {
 27 |     this.component = component;
 28 |     this.logLevel = logLevel;
 29 |   }
 30 | 
 31 |   /**
 32 |    * Log debug message
 33 |    */
 34 |   debug(message: string, data?: any): void {
 35 |     this.log(LogLevel.DEBUG, message, data);
 36 |   }
 37 | 
 38 |   /**
 39 |    * Log info message
 40 |    */
 41 |   info(message: string, data?: any): void {
 42 |     this.log(LogLevel.INFO, message, data);
 43 |   }
 44 | 
 45 |   /**
 46 |    * Log warning message
 47 |    */
 48 |   warn(message: string, data?: any): void {
 49 |     this.log(LogLevel.WARN, message, data);
 50 |   }
 51 | 
 52 |   /**
 53 |    * Log error message
 54 |    */
 55 |   error(message: string, error?: any): void {
 56 |     this.log(LogLevel.ERROR, message, error);
 57 |   }
 58 | 
 59 |   /**
 60 |    * Internal logging method
 61 |    */
 62 |   private log(level: LogLevel, message: string, data?: any): void {
 63 |     if (level < this.logLevel) {
 64 |       return;
 65 |     }
 66 | 
 67 |     const entry: LogEntry = {
 68 |       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 69 |       level,
 70 |       component: this.component,
 71 |       message,
 72 |       data
 73 |     };
 74 | 
 75 |     const formattedMessage = this.formatLogEntry(entry);
 76 |     
 77 |     switch (level) {
 78 |       case LogLevel.DEBUG:
 79 |         console.debug(formattedMessage);
 80 |         break;
 81 |       case LogLevel.INFO:
 82 |         console.info(formattedMessage);
 83 |         break;
 84 |       case LogLevel.WARN:
 85 |         console.warn(formattedMessage);
 86 |         break;
 87 |       case LogLevel.ERROR:
 88 |         console.error(formattedMessage);
 89 |         break;
 90 |     }
 91 |   }
 92 | 
 93 |   /**
 94 |    * Format log entry for output
 95 |    */
 96 |   private formatLogEntry(entry: LogEntry): string {
 97 |     const levelName = LogLevel[entry.level];
 98 |     let formatted = `[${entry.timestamp}] ${levelName} [${entry.component}] ${entry.message}`;
 99 |     
100 |     if (entry.data) {
101 |       formatted += `\n${JSON.stringify(entry.data, null, 2)}`;
102 |     }
103 |     
104 |     return formatted;
105 |   }
106 | 
107 |   /**
108 |    * Set log level
109 |    */
110 |   setLogLevel(level: LogLevel): void {
111 |     this.logLevel = level;
112 |   }
113 | 
114 |   /**
115 |    * Get current log level
116 |    */
117 |   getLogLevel(): LogLevel {
118 |     return this.logLevel;
119 |   }
120 | }
121 |

 1 | import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
 2 | import type { Logger } from '../../src/utils/logger';
 3 | 
 4 | /**
 5 |  * Create a mock logger for testing
 6 |  */
 7 | export function createMockLogger(): jest.Mocked<Logger> {
 8 |   return {
 9 |     debug: jest.fn(),
10 |     info: jest.fn(),
11 |     warn: jest.fn(),
12 |     error: jest.fn(),
13 |     setLevel: jest.fn(),
14 |     getLevel: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('info'),
15 |     child: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
16 |     addContext: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
17 |     removeContext: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
18 |     clearContext: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
19 |     getContext: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({}),
20 |     startTimer: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
21 |       end: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(100)
22 |     }),
23 |     profile: jest.fn(),
24 |     stream: jest.fn(),
25 |     close: jest.fn()
26 |   } as jest.Mocked<Logger>;
27 | }
28 | 
29 | /**
30 |  * Create a mock logger with specific behavior
31 |  */
32 | export function createMockLoggerWithBehavior(behavior: Partial<Logger>): jest.Mocked<Logger> {
33 |   const mockLogger = createMockLogger();
34 |   
35 |   Object.assign(mockLogger, behavior);
36 |   
37 |   return mockLogger;
38 | }
39 | 
40 | /**
41 |  * Verify logger calls in tests
42 |  */
43 | export function expectLoggerCalls(
44 |   mockLogger: jest.Mocked<Logger>,
45 |   expectedCalls: {
46 |     debug?: number;
47 |     info?: number;
48 |     warn?: number;
49 |     error?: number;
50 |   }
51 | ) {
52 |   if (expectedCalls.debug !== undefined) {
53 |     expect(mockLogger.debug).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectedCalls.debug);
54 |   }
55 |   if (expectedCalls.info !== undefined) {
56 |     expect(mockLogger.info).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectedCalls.info);
57 |   }
58 |   if (expectedCalls.warn !== undefined) {
59 |     expect(mockLogger.warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectedCalls.warn);
60 |   }
61 |   if (expectedCalls.error !== undefined) {
62 |     expect(mockLogger.error).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(expectedCalls.error);
63 |   }
64 | }
65 | 
66 | /**
67 |  * Reset all mock logger calls
68 |  */
69 | export function resetMockLogger(mockLogger: jest.Mocked<Logger>): void {
70 |   Object.values(mockLogger).forEach(mockFn => {
71 |     if (jest.isMockFunction(mockFn)) {
72 |       mockFn.mockClear();
73 |     }
74 |   });
75 | }
